```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_load(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.gt"))
```


# Add population metadata

```{r}
# why is class getting dropped here?

pop_names <- read.csv(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/igsr-1000-genomes-phase-3-release.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# find matching id in pop_names Sample.name and mad_bor_g1000_sum id, and for the matches, replace the population in mad_bor_g1000_sum with the population in pop_names
for(i in 1:nrow(pop_names)){
  if(pop_names$Sample.name[i] %in% mad_bor_g1000_sum$id){
    mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$id == pop_names$Sample.name[i], "population"] <- pop_names$Population.name[i]
  }
}

# replace "Luhya,Luhya" with "Luhya"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Luhya,Luhya"] <- "Luhya"
# replace "Esan,Esan" with "Esan"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Esan,Esan"] <- "Esan"
# replace "Gambian Mandinka,Gambian" with "Gambian Mandinka"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Gambian Mandinka,Gambian"] <- "Gambian_Mandinka"
# replace "Mende,Mende" with "Mende"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Mende,Mende"] <- "Mende"
# replace "Kinh,Kinh Vietnamese" with "Kinh Vietnamese"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Kinh,Kinh Vietnamese"] <- "Kinh_Vietnamese"
# replcae "Punjabi,Punjabi" with "Punjabi"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Punjabi,Punjabi"] <- "Punjabi"
# replcae "Benga,Bengali" with "Bengali"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Bengali,Bengali"] <- "Bengali"

# replace any _ with a space
#mad_bor_g1000_sum$population <- gsub("_", " ", mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)

# replace any " " in $populaiton with a "_"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population <- gsub(" ", "_", mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

# Remove existing plink files and rewrite

```{r}
if(file.exists(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.bed"))){
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.bed"))
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.bim"))
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.fam"))
}

gt_as_plink(mad_bor_g1000_sum, resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum"))
```

# Read the plink file and set 6th col to 1

```{r}
# read resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.fam")
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.fam"), header = FALSE, sep = " ")
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$V6 <- 1
write.table(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam, resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.fam"), row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, sep = " ")
```


